item.title: How to debounce scroll event in JavaScript
item.description: Debouncing scroll events is crucial for preventing performance issues caused by the high frequency of scroll event firing during user scrolling. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve optimized scroll event handling in numerous interactive components and infinite scroll implementations. From my expertise, the most effective approach is creating a debounced function that delays scroll handler execution until scrolling activity stops. This technique dramatically reduces CPU usage while maintaining responsive user interactions.
